net.en: The fisherman repaired the torn net beside the quiet harbor.
net.zh: 漁夫在安靜的港邊修補破掉的網。

nickel.en: The old machine accepted a nickel as part of the payment.
nickel.zh: 那台舊機器可以接受五分硬幣作為部分付款。

nickname.en: Her nickname came from a funny story in elementary school.
nickname.zh: 她的綽號來自小學時的一個有趣故事。

niece.en: My niece borrowed several picture books from the library.
niece.zh: 我的姪女從圖書館借了幾本圖畫書。

nightmare.en: The strange dream felt like a nightmare until he woke up.
nightmare.zh: 那個怪夢像惡夢一樣，直到他醒來才結束。

noble.en: The novel praises a noble leader who protects the community.
noble.zh: 這本小說讚揚一位保護社區的高尚領袖。

nod.en: She gave a quick nod to show that she understood.
nod.zh: 她快速點頭，表示自己明白了。

noisy.en: The hallway became noisy when classes ended for the day.

nominate.en: Students may nominate a classmate for the service award.
nominate.zh: 學生可以提名同學角逐服務獎。

nomination.en: Her nomination surprised her because she had not expected recognition.
nomination.zh: 她的提名讓她很驚訝，因為她沒預期會受到肯定。

nominee.en: Each nominee gave a short speech before the final vote.
nominee.zh: 每位候選人都在最後投票前發表簡短演說。

nonprofit.en: The nonprofit provides free tutoring for children after school.
nonprofit.zh: 這個非營利組織在放學後提供兒童免費課輔。

nonsense.en: The teacher asked us to separate evidence from obvious nonsense.
nonsense.zh: 老師要我們把證據和明顯的胡說區分開來。

noodle.en: A single noodle fell from the bowl onto the table.
noodle.zh: 一根麵條從碗裡掉到桌上。

noon.en: The meeting will begin at noon in the main office.
noon.zh: 會議將在中午於主要辦公室開始。

nope.en: He smiled and said nope when asked about the rumor.
nope.zh: 有人問起那個謠言時，他笑著說不。

nor.en: She neither complained nor blamed anyone for the delayed train.
nor.zh: 她既沒有抱怨，也沒有責怪任何人火車誤點。

norm.en: Recycling has become the norm in many schools and offices.
norm.zh: 資源回收已成為許多學校與辦公室的常態。

nostril.en: Cold air entered each nostril as he stepped outside.
nostril.zh: 他走到戶外時，冷空氣進入每個鼻孔。

notebook.en: I wrote the new vocabulary words in my notebook.
notebook.zh: 我把新的單字寫在筆記本裡。

noticeable.en: There was a noticeable improvement in her pronunciation this semester.
noticeable.zh: 她這學期的發音有明顯進步。

notify.en: Please notify the teacher if the classroom projector stops working.
notify.zh: 如果教室投影機停止運作，請通知老師。

notorious.en: The intersection is notorious for heavy traffic during rush hour.
notorious.zh: 這個路口以尖峰時段交通壅塞而出名。

novice.en: A novice can still learn quickly with clear instructions and practice.
novice.zh: 新手只要有清楚指導與練習，仍能快速學習。

nowhere.en: The missing key was nowhere to be found after lunch.
nowhere.zh: 午餐後到處都找不到那把遺失的鑰匙。

nuclear.en: The class debated the benefits and risks of nuclear energy.
nuclear.zh: 全班討論核能的優點與風險。

nucleus.en: The diagram shows the nucleus at the center of the cell.
nucleus.zh: 圖表顯示細胞核位於細胞中央。

nun.en: The historical novel includes a nun who teaches village children.
nun.zh: 這本歷史小說描寫一位教導村中孩子的修女。

nursery.en: The plant nursery sells young trees and flowers in spring.
nursery.zh: 這間苗圃在春天販售幼樹與花卉。

nurture.en: Good teachers nurture curiosity by welcoming thoughtful questions from students.
nurture.zh: 好老師藉由歡迎學生提出有思考的問題來培養好奇心。

nut.en: A squirrel carried a nut across the park path.
nut.zh: 一隻松鼠叼著一顆堅果穿過公園小徑。

nutrient.en: Iron is an important nutrient that the body needs.
nutrient.zh: 鐵是身體需要的重要營養素。

nutrition.en: The health class discussed nutrition and balanced meal planning.
nutrition.zh: 健康課討論營養與均衡飲食規劃。

nutritious.en: The cafeteria added more nutritious options to its lunch menu.
nutritious.zh: 餐廳在午餐菜單中增加更多營養選擇。

oak.en: A large oak shaded the benches beside the playground.
oak.zh: 一棵大橡樹為操場旁的長椅遮蔭。

oasis.en: The desert oasis provided water and shade for travelers.
oasis.zh: 沙漠綠洲為旅人提供水源與遮蔭。

oath.en: The official took an oath before beginning the new role.
oath.zh: 那位官員在開始新職務前宣誓。

oatmeal.en: She ate warm oatmeal with fruit before leaving for school.
oatmeal.zh: 她上學前吃了加水果的熱燕麥粥。

obedience.en: Blind obedience is not the same as thoughtful cooperation.
obedience.zh: 盲目服從並不等同於有思考的合作。

obedient.en: The obedient dog waited quietly beside its owner at the park.
obedient.zh: 那隻聽話的狗在公園裡安靜等在主人旁邊。

obey.en: Drivers must obey traffic signals to keep intersections safe.
obey.zh: 駕駛必須遵守交通號誌，以維持路口安全。

objection.en: She raised an objection when the proposal seemed unfair.
objection.zh: 當提案看起來不公平時，她提出反對意見。

obscure.en: The article explains an obscure historical event in simple language.
obscure.zh: 這篇文章用簡單語言解釋一個鮮為人知的歷史事件。

observation.en: Careful observation helped the students notice changes in the plants.
observation.zh: 仔細觀察幫助學生注意到植物的變化。

observer.en: Each observer recorded the birds seen near the lake.
observer.zh: 每位觀察者都記錄在湖邊看到的鳥類。

obsess.en: Do not obsess over one mistake when revising your essay.
obsess.zh: 修改作文時，不要過度糾結於一個錯誤。

obstacle.en: Limited time was the biggest obstacle facing the project team.
obstacle.zh: 時間有限是專題團隊面臨的最大障礙。

obstinate.en: The obstinate character refuses to change his mind despite new evidence.
obstinate.zh: 那個固執的角色即使看到新證據也不願改變想法。

occasional.en: An occasional mistake is normal while learning a new language.
occasional.zh: 學習新語言時偶爾犯錯很正常。

outlet.en: The shopping outlet offers several stores under one large roof.
outlet.zh: 這間購物中心在同一棟大型建築內有多家商店。
